title: Lottery.expectedValue_mix
body_html:
Lottery.expectedValue_mix

Lean type

lean theorem Lottery.expectedValue_mix (α : 𝕜) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α) (hα₁ : α ≤ 1) (L₁ L₂ : Lottery 𝕜 O) (f : O → 𝕜) : Lottery.expectedValue (Lottery.mix α hα₀ hα₁ L₁ L₂) f = α * Lottery.expectedValue L₁ f + (1 - α) * Lottery.expectedValue L₂ f

Dependencies

  • Lottery.expectedValue
